source.title: PIPELINE GATE 06/09 — New Product Candidate & Cross-Supplier Dedup
source.body:
# PIPELINE GATE 06/09 — New Product Candidate & Global Duplicate Guard

**Intent:** when Stage 04 did NOT safely identify an existing canonical SKU, either (A) prove enough new-item evidence and reuse/create a SINGLE ProductCandidate or (B) pause for review; then start slower shared Brand/Line/Ingredient intelligence work. **No unreviewed new public Product/SKU and no AI-only invention.** Parent AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#144; milestone EC-00; historical tasks AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#135 (identity), AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#137 (Brand/Line), AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#138 (Ingredient), AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#139 (Research), AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#141 (review/publish). These existing tasks may say Done but this 2026-10-22 acceptance is UNVERIFIED without code and real test evidence.

## 1. Happy path

* An approved-scope new supplier row passes Stages 01–03 and Stage 04 exact alias/barcode/catalog search.
* Stage 06 performs an **independent existing-record duplicate sweep before creating a new Candidate**: search canonical SKU/Product (published and unpublished/inactive, prior merged/alias history as applicable), *all* NEW/PENDING/IN_REVIEW ProductCandidates and previously reviewed equivalent pending entities, including those sourced from **different suppliers**.
* Match candidates by verified GTIN (with consistency checks), approved SupplierSKU alias scoped to that supplier, curated AR/EN brand+line aliases, exact sellable unit/fingerprint (brand/line, category, formulation/version, size/units and pack count), and bounded fuzzy bilingual retrieval. Do not treat a raw similar name as unique identity.
* **EXISTING SKU confirmed:** attach new supplier offer/alias to existing canonical identity and route verified rows to Stage 05; do NOT create a product/candidate.
* **PENDING Candidate confirmed:** attach an additional sourced row/supplier provenance/offer proposal to SAME candidate, dedup case; no second candidate.
* **Likely match, conflicting identity or insufficient minimum attributes:** route REVIEW with original row and contrasted matches; do not silently create NEW nor silently merge.
* **Genuinely new with adequate product identity evidence:** create/reuse unique ProductCandidate once, store raw source + source supplier + approved eligible category/brand policy version. Enqueue selective evidence-led research/Brand/Line/Ingredient knowledge; no forced AI calls on known-SKU offer lane and no auto-publish.
* Later Stage 07 does full product fact/media enrichment, and Stage 08 **rechecks cross-catalog and pending Candidate duplicates atomically immediately before approving Product/SKU publication**. A candidate being new at import does not guarantee it is new at publish time.

## 2. Defense in depth / implementation technique (audit real backend first)

1. Reuse AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#135 match helpers, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#8 product fingerprints, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#128 variant/barcode rules, existing Prisma ProductCandidate, Catalog/Sourcing and research modules. Search should include already-reviewed hidden/unpublished catalog products and pending candidates, not just Storefront visible sellables.
2. **Canonical identity signature is scoped to sufficient independently verified fields**, e.g. brand identity + exact formulation/version + normalized net-size/unit + manufacturer pack + variant. A partial name or brand/size alone is not safe as a hard unique key. GTIN may be missing/misassigned; retain evidence source.
3. Preserve distinct product, sellable variant/SKU, manufacturer multipack, supplier trade carton, retailer promotion and vendor offer identities. GS1 rules indicate net contents, material formulation, pack quantity and promotional identity may require separate GTINs: [https://www.gs1.org/1/gtinrules/en/](<https://www.gs1.org/1/gtinrules/en/>) ; [https://www.gs1.org/1/gtinrules/en/rule/266/declared-net-content](<https://www.gs1.org/1/gtinrules/en/rule/266/declared-net-content>)
4. Avoid the classic check-then-create race: use existing DB canonical key/index/uniqueness where complete identity supports it plus bounded transaction, appropriate locking / conflict re-read or conditional UPSERT in Postgres 17. Need to inspect current schema, **no speculative new constraint or remote migration**. Docs: [https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/indexes-unique.html](<https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/indexes-unique.html>) ; [https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/sql-insert.html](<https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/sql-insert.html>)
5. Persist approved supplier alias after confirmed manual review so future files bypass fuzzy/AI. New-product research can reuse a single Brand/Line/Ingredient pending knowledge record across multiple candidates; missing official logo should not block intake; exact real packshot needed for storefront publication. No AI-generated product picture, bogus INCI or unsupported claims.
6. Research calls bounded/asynchronous to existing FastAPI provider; prompt/content cannot assign canonical product IDs, publish SKU or overwrite purchase/selling prices. Source attribution and unknown facts remain first-class.

## 3. Worst/adversarial scenarios → safe result

* Same new item from Supplier A and B with different Arabic/EN slang and missing barcodes: dedup against live/pending candidates using independent identity evidence; if uncertain, REVIEW rather than create duplicate.
* A current unpublished/inactive SKU already exists, but is absent from public search: identify existing canonical item; never treat as new simply because not sellable.
* Two upload workers race to create same candidate: single canonical candidate if identity provable, transactional conflict re-read; otherwise hold possible duplicate for review.
* Existing SKU 200ml vs supplier 400ml: distinct new SKU candidate; don't merge by brand/line alone.
* 2 × 100ml manufacturer multipack vs single 200ml, supplier trade carton of 12 vs one unit, 1+1 promo vs ordinary unit: treat as distinct sellable/unit situations or normalize trade pack on actual source semantics; REVIEW uncertain.
* Brand transliterations, old/new packaging, new formula, same title, wrong GTIN, bogus checksum-valid GTIN, missing brand/size or synonym collision: independent veto + REVIEW, not AI-based auto merge.
* AI confident 'new' while search finds existing plausible record: REVIEW; AI confident 'same' while formulation or volume conflicts: REJECT merge.
* Brand approved and product type approved yet product absent: legitimate Candidate (not SKIP). Unapproved unclear brand / out-of-scope sure: Stage 03 REVIEW / SKIP appropriately.
* Research provider outage or budget exceeded: Candidate remains pending/resumable, known supplier offers continue in Stage 05; no duplicate research loops.
* Row rejected/merged then uploaded again: use reviewed resolutions and source provenance, no resurrected duplicate or lost supplier history.
* Product discovered during research Stage 07 or concurrently published before Stage 08: final recheck and merge/link rather than double publish.

## 4. Evidence-driven acceptance

- [ ] Inspect actual candidate create/match transaction, indexes, source-to-candidate/offer links, existing Brand/Line/Ingredient service and repository SHA.
- [ ] Case: first newly proven Product creates exactly 1 Candidate; second upload same supplier and different supplier name/alias reuses that record, links both source rows without losing supplier ownership.
- [ ] Case: same SKU exists but unpublished/inactive, repeated imports after rejection, barcode conflict, reformulation, 200 vs 400 ml and multipack/promo each return correct MATCH / NEW / REVIEW without bad merge.
- [ ] Two concurrent unknown imports cannot silently create duplicate Product/SKU/Candidate; measure with DB before/after.
- [ ] No product is published or attributed false fact solely by AI; missing/ambiguous fields lead review and no fake packshot.
- [ ] Resumable research/knowledge reuse and provider outage tested; Stage 05 known-offer lane unaffected.
- [ ] Candidate/Brand/Line reuse, source/provenance/audit, admin review UI, exact test commands/measurements reported.
- [ ] Stage 08 final atomic pre-publish dedup remains mandatory; no claim of Stage 06 DONE without it independently passing its own tests.

**HARD STOP:** confirmed duplicate creation, merge of different size/formulation/pack identities, missing tenant provenance, unreviewed public listing, hallucinated identity evidence or destructive Supabase changes.

## 5. Evidence sheet — fill after code inspection

| Check | Actual code/DB source | Test evidence | Verdict |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |

**Next Stage 07:** evidence-based product enrichment: official facts, ingredient ontology, routine placement, AR/EN content and matching original product packshot.
